definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese sliding door or room divider made of a wooden frame covered with translucent paper.

examples.japanese: {障子|しょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I opened the shoji and looked outside.

examples.japanese: {障子|しょうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}える→張り替える：28418_harikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm replacing the paper on the shoji.

examples.japanese: {障子|しょうじ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Soft light comes through the shoji.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{障子|しょうじ} are traditional sliding doors covered with washi (Japanese paper). They allow soft, diffused light to enter while providing privacy. Found in traditional Japanese rooms (⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {障子|しょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧/⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ (to open/close the shoji)
- {障子|しょうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}え→張り替え：noentry⟧ (replacing shoji paper)
- {障子|しょうじ}⟦{紙|がみ}→障子紙：16594_shoujigami⟧ (shoji paper)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧ - fusuma (opaque sliding door, often decorated)
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{戸|ど}→引き戸：27509_hikido⟧ - sliding door (general term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{障子|しょうじ} = translucent paper (lets light through)
⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧ = opaque (painted/decorated, blocks light)
